title: unified-rollouts: enhance shadow/canary autorollback policy and metrics matching
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Improve unified rollouts by tightening shadow/canary autorollback decision logic, adding aggregate metric matching, and exposing new rollout-level histograms for latency and error rate. Backwards-compatible. Included in 1.12.0-RC.
description:
Motivation: We've observed a number of noisy auto-rollbacks in shadow and small-canary scenarios where metric sparse sampling and distribution shifts trigger false positives. This causes unnecessary rollbacks and flaps for low-traffic rollouts. This PR tightens the autorollback decision logic by adding aggregate metric matching, minimum-sample safeguards, cooldown windows, and better observability for rollout-level metrics.

What this change does (summary):
- Introduces a metric comparator that performs weighted quantile matching and enforces minimum sample counts for a metric to be considered for rollback decisions.
- Adds a cooldown window and per-stage minimum duration to prevent rapid flip-flops after brief transient spikes.
- Emits new rollout-level histograms (latency P50/P90/P99 and error-rate buckets) which are exported to Prometheus for both shadow and canary traffic.
- Extends the rollout policy DSL with `min_samples`, `aggregate_method`, and `cooldown_seconds` parameters. Old policies default to previous behavior to remain backwards-compatible.
- Adds end-to-end tests that exercise a simulated traffic generator to validate that autorollbacks don't trigger for statistically insignificant deviations.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc and Linear tickets referenced (ENG-4621, ENG-4690)
- [x] Implementation of comparator + policy extension
- [x] Unit tests for metric matcher edge cases
- [x] E2E simulation test that reproduces previous false-positive scenario
- [x] Updated rollout docs and SDK examples
- [x] Observability dashboards/histograms added

Commit summary: Squashed changes from feature branch: rollout policy engine, metric comparator, observability metrics, e2e tests, docs. 8 logical commits consolidated. Key commits: implement metric comparator, add cooldown logic, add histograms export, update rollout controller, add e2e simulation, docs and examples.

Changed areas (high level):
- rollouts/policy/autorollback.go: main policy enforcement updates and cooldown logic
- rollouts/policy/metric_matcher.go: new comparator implementing weighted quantile and sample-count checks
- rollouts/handlers/rollout_controller.go: integrate comparator into decision path and surface debug logs
- observability/metrics/rollout_histograms.prom: new metrics exposition for rollouts
- e2e/rollout/smoke_test.go: simulation harness for canary/shadow scenarios
- docs/rollouts/autorollback.md: guidance and examples for new policy parameters
- sdk-js/src/rollouts.ts, sdk-py/redwood/rollouts.py: small SDK helpers to set rollout policy options
- ci/rollouts_integration.yaml: add integration job for rollout e2e tests
- charts/redwood-rollouts/values.yaml: chart defaults for new rollout metrics
- tests/fixtures/rollouts/sample_canary.json: fixture for e2e tests
- charts/redwood-rollouts/templates/deployment.yaml

Testing: Unit test coverage added for quantile matcher and sample-count gating. E2E simulation reproduces prior flaky rollback and demonstrates no rollback when traffic below min_samples or when differences are within configured aggregate tolerance. Integration CI initially failed lint (naming), then passed after fix; full pipeline pass recorded on 2026-02-24.

Review conversation (summary):
- Liam: Requested clearer invariants around `min_samples` and an explicit example showing the interaction between `min_samples` and `cooldown_seconds`. Also asked for a property test for the comparator to avoid regressions.
- Author (Priya): Added property-based unit test and updated docs with three concrete examples and recommended defaults (min_samples: 200 for production, 20 for low-traffic experiments).
- Chen: Asked for more observability (histograms) and that rollout UI show sample counts; I added per-rollout histograms and wire-up in the metrics exporter, and updated rollout controller to emit sample_count metric.
- Mateo: Performed a full e2e run against a staging cluster with a simulated heavy-tailed latency distribution. Approved after CI and e2e green.
